reviews.comment: The class was mostly taught by guest speakers, and all of them were great. Prof. Skaggs was really kind and the TA was too. There is a quiz after every lecture, so you really have to go to every class. The final was really easy and he gives a good study guide for it
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In ANSC 108, it is required that you take it alongside ANSC 107. You review similar material in both classes, but some details in both textbooks contradict. This is challenging when studying for exams for both tests in the same week. This class is taught by a TA, some of whom are not ANSC majors and cannot answer questions. Overall, an easy class.

goated class. Again very reliant on who the TA is as it is a lab section technically under Skaggs but he is only in the picture during exams. super easy labs but there is a quiz at the end of each for attendance. Three exams, no final, Skaggs gives you all the questions to the exam at the review nights.

Wasn't a hard class at all, just guest speakers and a three question quiz at the end of each lecture that was a super easy attendance grade. Class is easy but the current TA graded very very harshly for a 101 class, however would let you redo assignments. Skaggs never really taught anything so it is very reliant on who the TA is.
Teacher aids are the worst beware
108 is a breeze! The TAs are very good at teaching you and the review sessions before the test really do help so go to those!!!! As long as you show up and go to the review sessions you will pass.
if you want to transfer credits to a different uni dont bother taking this class
waste of time class

Super easy class and is an easy A. The TA's post slides about the guest speakers so if you show up late you can still take the attendance quizzes. Assignments were really easy and the review for the final is very accurate for the final exam.
The best professor! ANSC 101 was an easy A! Guest lectures every class and after class assignments that are taken as attendance and a grade. A few writing assignments and then one final test.

in class attendance quiz, only one test which is the final, assignments were not very hard but I would recommend sending it to the TA to check before submitting.
I love Dr. Skaggs but I wouldn't have taken this class if i would have known that he has nothing to actually do with this class other then being there sometimes.
Dr. Skaggs is an amazing professor and I highly recommend taking his classes!
not much to say other than his courses are easy. both for ansc 101 and 108, everything is super straight forward and its impossible to fail if u study
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really felt this class could have been so much better with Skaggs teaching it, but I know he isn't technically a teacher for 108. The TA that taught my class was nice, but it was boring hearing them just repeat everything off the slides or book. They added nothing to the discussions either because they didn't know or they didn't care to. Easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is held once a week where a guest speaker from the agricultural industry speaks to the students. Grade is mainly based on attendance, plus a few easy assignments. It is required that you attend the career fair in September, but that's the only thing you have to physically do outside of class. Easy A as long as you show up.

Each week there would be speakers who talked about different careers and/or topics related to Animal Science. At the end of class there would be an attendance quiz with easy questions. Required to attend the career fair, 2 writing assignments, 1 exam that he provides a study guide for. Easy A as long as you show up.

Incredibly easy class. I had a great TA who taught, but the class is still overall really easy. He goes over all material needed for the exams almost word for word. There's a quiz at the end of each class for attendance and filler grades, questions and answers are reviewed right before you take it. GPA boosting class, didn't study much.

If you complete the canvas test reviews AND go to the in-person test review, you will be prepared for the exams. There is very little hands-on work, so the class is mostly just learning the material in the book. It is taught entirely by the TAs but Dr. Skaggs leads the review sessions. Prepare for both multiple choice and written portions.

Straightforward and an easy A if you do all of your assignments. Each week is a different guest lecturer with an attendance quiz about the lecture at the end. The only exam is the final, which is all multiple choice and true false, but he gives you a test review which covers everything you need to know to ace it.

lab was graded off of weekly attendance quizzes (super easy but only worth a few points) and exams. i had a different TA, but really succeeded because of his test reviews. he went word-for-word with what would be on exams. show up to reviews and take his lab section if u can!

highly recommend, skaggs is awesome :D class met once a week with quizzes for attendance and points. had to build a college resume and attend the AGLS career fair for a reflection paper. very easy final with a review beforehand over guest speakers and COALS faculty/procedures/etc. very easy course, just show up!

super easy class and caring prof, as long as you go. attendance is taken via daily quiz in both lecture and lab. 108 exams can be tough if the TAs give the exam review but if Skaggs gives the review, he will tell you EXACTLY what you need to know for the exam. Downside is he only gave 1 of the many exam reviews. study for 108 exams + go to 101 = A

ansc 101 is a pretty easy & chill class although attendance is mandatory through quizzes at the end of every class & it was at 8am which wasn't fun. Prof Skaggs was an ok prof but the TA did most of the work with grades / assignments & there were a lot of quest speakers. There are only a few assignments throughout the semester that were pretty easy
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I HIGHLY recommend getting into the section of 108 where Skaggs is the teacher if you can. My TA was great, but he is going to give you a more accurate review for the tests since he writes them. Easy to get an A even if he isn't your teacher. Some TAs held review sessions before each test, but they did a bad job giving us a good review.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is a great 101 class! He brings in industry lecturers that you can easily make connections with. I know of people that got into research just by talking to the lecturers after class. Few homework assignments, and the final is easy as long as you study the review they provide (I got a 100 on it easy). Great class for intro to college!

The ANSC 108 is a little different bc you don't really ever see Dr Skaggs. You only work with the TA and if you get dealt a horrible TA then you're screwed. I wish Skaggs did actually teach this class but instead, you just get set with some random TA that probably knows nothing about what you're learning.

Dr. Skaggs is great and highly respected by many. He requires attendance by taking easy participation quiz at the end of each class. The content exam at the end of the semester is a little difficult but it's just over everything on the review just study the review. He's very transparent and has a TA that sends out announcements often

In this lab, you won't necessarily be interacting much with Professor Skaggs, mostly TAs or other speakers. The quizzes are super easy and if you attend the review session before each of the 2 tests you are practically guaranteed an A or high B. If you're a BIMS (Pre-Vet) major like me you can take this class just email the ANSC department.

Go to every class, it's not worth missing (even if it's at 8am). Attendance is mandatory, and pay attention to the lectures since they will be brought up again on the final exam. For the final, study the review they provide for a couple of hours and you will do good!

Pay attention in every lab and take notes if needed. There is a quiz every class over the content you learn, but if you have a good TA you will be fine! GO TO THE REVIEW SESSIONS. I cannot stress that enough. They tell you EXACTLY what you need to study to do good on the 3 tests throughout the semester.

Class is taught entirely by TA's so you have to get lucky to have a good one. Attendance is mandatory- there is a quiz in every class. A review is given for the exams which do require some studying. Although this is a lab class, it is 95% PowerPoint and lecture-based. You will see some animals, but overall this course is pretty boring.
Very easy course. Weekly quizzes mean attendance is essential. The answers are given to you in the lecture that day so this course does not require studying. Show up to class and you will get an A.

The class was not very interesting, but it is required. Most of the time there were guest speakers who lecture on topics like financial literacy, study abroad, or civil discourse. Daily attendance quizzes after every lecture and one test for a final. While it wasn't the most fun class, it was helpful in some aspects.
This class is really boring, and attendance is required. Every class is going to be a guest speaker and most of the time he isn't even in class.

TA run class with attendance quizzes are for a grade so must attend. Exam reviews are given as well as some extra credit that is worth quite a bit. Hands-on so be prepared to see lots of animals. 3 exams and honestly, if you do well on every quiz you can get 70's on exams and still pass with an 80.

Lectures mainly included guest speakers to talk about their career fields. Homework includes a resume, essay, and career network event. Attendance quiz for grade means you must attend but can be easily made up if you miss. 1 exam but review is given.

The professor always had guest speakers and never seemed interested in the class. The assignments could be done during lecture, were only about 4 questions long, and were easy so I didn't care. I'd take this course as a minor GPA booster again for sure.

Weekly quizzes, and lots of assignments for a 1 hour credit course. Must attend the career fair during the semester. Attendance is mandatory and is taken through a weekly quiz online and from attendance in class where you have an assigned seat.

If you are taking Skaggs for ANSC 108 you wont really interact with him at all, the lab will be taught by a TA. I had a wonderful TA and lab was lecture heavy but you get to tour different ANSC buildings and interact with animals. For the tests Skaggs gives a review of EXACTLY what is on the test so do those and study them.
Super nice professor. Not difficult at all. Just make sure to study for the final and you'll do great.

You have to do nothing in 101. It's a basic introduction class to what A&M has to offer for Animal Science majors. Just little two question quizzes for attendance at the end of class, then a final, that's it.
Doesn't do a whole lot of teaching mainly just has guest speakers every week. Easy enough class though, very few assignments. Just go to class so you don't have to take the final.
This teacher never even teaches, he has a guest speaker every single day while the TA's grade all the quizzes and exams. If I worked at this school I'd want his job, gets paid for nothing.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Easy A. Simply put. He is also a great person outside of just being a good professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had him for my Hullabaloo U class, and he was amazing. He cares about his students and wants you to be prepared for anything that college throws at you. You need to show up but other than that there is not much (very few assignments, but they are so worth it) if you get the chance to take him, do it.

Dr. Skaggs is one of the best profs I have had. We had plenty of time to complete our tests which were open note, no homework and the answers come straight from the text book! A laid back class, but I was definitely able to learn.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class was an underclassman elective class focused on transitioning to college. Prof. Skaggs is one of the best professors I've had. He was extremely helpful and funny. He makes you feel like you can talk to him about anything, even your personal life. Would DEFINITELY recommend him as a professor if you have the option!

Once a week class with new guest speakers every week. This is more of a "get to know what opportunities you have here at Texas A&M" class. Quizzes at the end of every class over the presentations. Just attend class and you will most likely get an A, this class was so easy. I skipped 3 lecture days and still got an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Once a week class with new guest speakers every week. This is more of a "get to know what opportunities you have here at Texas A&M" class. Quizzes at the end of every class over the presentations. Two additional easy assignments and one exam at the end. If you memorize the study guide, you will make a 100.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy A, as long as you go to class and do the attendance assignments its hard to not pass. When it comes time for the final. look at the final for just a little and you will be fine. Dr. Skaggs is awesome! I had him for ANSC 108 too and he was an amazing teacher. I highly recommend him!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Hands down the best professor/mentor at TAMU! He truly cares about you and your future success. I highly recommend this class and Dr. Skaggs to everyone its that great!

The class is set up so most of your points are attendance "quizzes" about what the guest speaker for that week was talking about at the end of class, along with two assignments that are also graded very easily, and then the test which he gives you a review for. (The review is basically the test) Skaggs is great!
Go to class to get credit points for being there and you will get an A. He gives you a review for the final which is the only test you have, study that and you will be fine.

This class is the easiest class you will ever take at TAMU. As long as you go to the lecture, you will get an A. He gives a quiz at the end of every class over what the lecture was about. It There is like 2 papers and one test. It is impossible to fail as long as you show up and do the work.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Skaggs will always be a favorite professor of mine. He shows respect for his students and the agriculture community. He has made a positive start to my college career. I look forward to taking more of his courses in the future. He is good at making you think about your future and what YOU need to do to obtain your goals.

The hardest thing about this class was showing up. Easy assignments and one test at the end of the year that takes 10 minutes to take. Just show up and pay attention to the speakers that come in and take some notes
Dr. Skaggs class is very very easy! just show up to class and you'll have a free 100... make sure you take a little bit of notes so you can pass the quizzes
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The attendance quizzes are technically collaborative and the final test takes almost no effort. The only annoying part of the class is the required attendance of the career fair, but it takes max 30 minutes.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Would take again

reviews.comment: All you have to do is show up for attendance and take the quiz over what you went over that day. Very easy class is an amazing GPA booster. There is one final at the end and you get a study guide with all of the notes from the semester and the final is the easiest and only exam you will take
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: Dr. Skaggs is an amazing man, and I'm glad I got to take his course.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: You basically just show up and get your A. Easiest class you'll ever take.
Need a GPA booster? TAKE THIS CLASS! If you attend every class and do every hw (he gives you a 100 on every assignment) all you have to make on the final is a 50 and you still make an A in the class!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Hands down the easiest class I've ever taken. If you need a class to brag to your parents about how well you are doing in it, you've come to the right place. Do the right thing and go buy yourself an "A" for this semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Having Dr. Skaggs for AGLS 101 was an easy A. You just need to show up every week and complete the 3 assignments assigned. He gives out a study guide the week before the final, which is everything we went through the semester. Final exam was easy as well. He says that the quickest time someone completed the exam was 5 minutes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Every week there will be a quiz for attendance, so don't skip. Presenters are there in order to help you with connections or life skills. Major grades are the final test and a résume. As long as you take light notes during each presentation for the quizzes, you will be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class felt like a waste of time because of how easy it was. You do learn a lot about the college of agriculture and life science, but attendance is mandatory. You are guaranteed an A if you show up to every single class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: All you have to do is show up and take some notes. Every class is a guest speaker and the exam is over everyone who came and spoke.

Easiest class you will ever take. There are guest speakers every week, and a small 2-3 question quiz after each speaker that is just a participation grade. Show up to class and you will pass whether to pay attention or not. The final is easy and he gives out a review that have everything that will be on the final.

Really easy class. It's just a guest speaker every week. There is an attendance class every day but only three super easy questions. If you even barely pay attention during class then you will get a 100 on the quizz. Final was super easy and he gave you an outline with all the material. No textbook and no noted needed. Definetely a GPA booster

AGLS 101 is an easy class. Show up and listen to the guest lecturers. Turn in the bell ringer quiz. Rinse and repeat.   You have a handful of assignments that require time outside of class.  Easy final, he gives you a review of everything you need to know at the final lecture.  The grade distribution speaks for itself.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Amazing life advice! Easiest class I've ever taken.
Easiest class ever. Show up to class (attendance is the biggest part of your grade) and you'll make an A. You don't even have to take notes.
Show up for this class and you will pass (seriously attendance is the majority of the grade). Turn in 2 assignments and the beginning of the year and take a final at the end. Easiest A ever.

Attendance is a quiz grade every week. The class is only 50 minutes so just go. There are only a couple assignments and they're easy. He gives you all the notes you need for the final so don't worry about taking notes. I wish I could take this class every semester.
Has different lecturers come in every class. Has one test which is the final, very few grades but class attendance is the biggest one.
Class is an easy A he gives all the answers right before the quizzes which are weekly and tests are long but super easy.
Show up, do the work, and you'll make an A. Really just a class for getting information.

Easiest class of my life. You have to go to class because at the end of every class there is a short 1-3 question quiz (which you can do with friends & he usually gives the answers to), attend ACE day, write a short paper, and plug info into a resume template. Final exam is his review word for word. Easy 100, learn a lot

You have a short quiz every class but it's not hard and it's only for attendance so you DO have to show up to class! If you somewhat listen to the guest speakers during class, go to ACE day (you'll figure out what that is) and write your reflection, and sort of study the final exam review you will pass this class with an easy A! Prof is very chill!

Provides you with many guest speakers to teach you about making good habits and learning opportunities within the university. Provides you with extra credit. You need to show up to class because there is a quiz everyday (Easy A).
